# BB00614: Li'th-Thamara {.unnumbered}

God is Most Great with exceeding greatness

This is a missive from God, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting, unto God, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting. Say: All have their beginning from God. Say: All return unto God.

This is a letter from Ali-Before-Nabil, the Remembrance of God unto the worlds, unto him whose name is equivalent to the name of Wahid [Yahya], the Remembrance of God unto the worlds. Say: All have their beginning from the Point of the Bayan.

O thou who art named Wahid! Preserve what hath been revealed in the Bayan and what hath been commanded therein, for verily thou art upon a mighty straight path.

(sealed:) Verily I am the proof of God and His light.
